QuestInfo.name: The Importance of Laughing
QuestInfo.0: #p3000017# looks hurt too. When did she get hurt?
QuestInfo.1: #p3000017# says what matters is that we are still alive. Reminds you of the strength of #p3000017#.
QuestInfo.2: #p3000017# says no one is strong from the start. Magnus was weak before he went to Darmoor to search for his power. She encourages you by saying you can be stronger than Magnus if you train hard.

0.0: Kaiser, you better leave #p3000016# alone for now.\r\n#L0##b#p3000013#, are you okay?#l\n#k
0.1: Me? This? Er, yeah! I'm fine. I just...tripped! On the stairs. Holding some knives. Clumsy me.\r\n#L0##bThat really doesn't look like something that happens by accident...#l\n#k
0.2: Um...So, how are you? You took Magnus head-on, huh? Crazy stuff.\r\n#L0##bYeah...he beat me up pretty good, but I'm okay. Say, how did you know about that?#l\n#k
0.3: Huh? I...y'know...heard. Stuff. You! I heard you! Talking to\r\n#p3000016#. Of course. Ha. Ha ha ha ha! Er, anyway, I guess things aren't too rosy between you and #p3000016#. Don't blame yourself, okay? You'll get Magnus next time. You're Kaiser, after all!

no.0: Everyone has off days. Yours just tend to hurt more, I guess.

1.0: You need to just laugh it off. What's the point of getting all mopey? It's hard to pound the bad guys with a frown on your face!
1.1: Magnus went to Darmoor to power up 'cause he was weak, remember? We can do the same! We'll train hard, and beat Magnus! And then Darmoor!
